system.description: A huge dragon with four powerful limbs and crimson-tinged wings.
system.notes:
Champion | Solo

A huge dragon with four powerful limbs and crimson-tinged wings.
Motives & Tactics: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, breathe flames, defend what is mine, maul

Difficulty: 20 | Thresholds: 15/25 | HP: 10 | Stress: 6

ATK: +6 | Bite & Claws: Close | 2d12+5 phy

Experience: Protect What Is Mine +3

Features

Relentless (3) - Passive: The Drachen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Rend and Crush - Passive: If a target damaged by the Drachen doesn’t mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

No Hope - Passive: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Drachen, they lose a Hope.

Tempest Wings - Action: Spend a Fear to flail the Drachen’s wings with explosive force, creating a shockwave within Close range. All targets in this area must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until they spend an action to right themselves or until they clear a Stress. For each PC that fails the roll, you gain a Fear.

Dragon's Breath - Action: Spend 2 Fear to release a burst of flames in front of the Drachen within Close range. All targets in this area must make a Finesse Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Burning until they steel themselves with a successful Brawn Roll. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

Flaming - Reaction: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Drachen from within Very Close, they must mark a Stress or become Burning until they put themselves out with a Finesse roll. While Burning, they take 2d6 magic damage when they have the spotlight.

Momentum - Reaction: When the Drachen makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
